name: PPN Rekonsiliasi
query:
SELECT
    'PPN Keluaran' AS "Type::100",
    si.name AS "Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:150",
    si.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    si.total_taxes_and_charges AS "Amount:Currency:150"
FROM
    `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE
    si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.total_taxes_and_charges > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'PPN Masukan' AS "Type::100",
    pi.name AS "Invoice:Link/Purchase Invoice:150",
    pi.bill_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    -pi.total_taxes_and_charges AS "Amount:Currency:150"
FROM
    `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
WHERE
    pi.docstatus = 1
    AND pi.total_taxes_and_charges > 0
ORDER BY
    Date DESC
